data = pd.read_csv('chunks_csv/moran_local_2021_waste.csv')
adjacency = pd.read_csv('chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv')

# Handle missing values
data['Waste_value'] = data['Waste_value'].fillna(data['Waste_value'].mean())

# Compute neighborhood waste generation
data['neighborhood_waste'] = data.apply(lambda row: adjacency[adjacency['borough'] == row['borough']]['neighbor'].map(data['Waste_value'].mean).mean() if row['borough'] in adjacency['neighbor'].values else np.nan, axis=1)

# Calculate local Moran's I
data['local_moran_i'] = data.apply(lambda row: np.mean((data['Waste_value'] - data['Waste_value'].mean()) * (data['neighborhood_waste'] - data['neighborhood_waste'].mean())) if row['borough'] in adjacency['neighbor'].values else np.nan, axis=1)

# Determine hot and cold spots
data['percentile'] = pd.qcut(data['Waste_value'], q=4, labels=[0, 25, 50, 75, 100], duplicates='drop')
data['hot_cold'] = np.where((data['Waste_value'] > data['percentile'].map({0: 0, 25: 0, 50: 0, 75: 1, 100: 1}).max()) & (data['local_moran_i'] > 0), 'HH', np.where((data['Waste_value'] < data['percentile'].map({0: 0, 25: 0, 50: 0, 75: 1, 100: 1}).min()) & (data['local_moran_i'] < 0), 'LL', np.nan)

# Perform permutation test
data['p_value'] = np.nan
for index, row in data.iterrows():
    if row['hot_cold'] == 'HH':
        data.loc[index, 'p_value'] = np.mean([np.mean(np.random.permutation(data['Waste_value'].values) * (data['neighborhood_waste'].values - data['neighborhood_waste'].mean())) for _ in range(500]])

        data.loc[index, 'p_value'] = np.mean([np.mean(np.random.permutation(data['Waste_value'].values) * (data['neighborhood_waste'].values - data['neighborhood_waste'].mean())) for _ in range(500]])

# Print results
data_points_used = data['Waste_value'].notna().sum()
print(f'data_points_used = {data_points_used}')

hot_cold_spots = data[(data['hot_cold'] == 'HH') | (data['hot_cold'] == 'LL')]
for index, row in hot_cold_spots.iterrows():
    print(f'FINAL ANSWER: {row["borough"]} ({row["hot_cold"]}, test statistic = {row["local_moran_i"]}, significance measure = {row["p_value"]})')

    local_morans_i[row['borough']] = np.corrcoef(row['Waste_value'], borough_data.loc[borough_data['borough'].isin(neighbors), 'Waste_value'])[0, 1]

adjacency_data = pd.read_csv('chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv')

# Handle missing values
borough_data['Waste_value'] = borough_data['Waste_value'].fillna(borough_data['Waste_value'].mean())

# Compute neighborhood waste generation
adjacency_data = adjacency_data.set_index('borough')
borough_data['neighbors'] = borough_data['borough'].apply(lambda x: adjacency_data.loc[x, 'neighbor'].tolist())
borough_data['neighbor_waste'] = borough_data['neighbors'].apply(lambda x: borough_data.loc[borough_data['borough'].isin(x), 'Waste_value'].mean())

# Identify hot and cold spots
borough_data['hot_cold'] = np.where((borough_data['Waste_value'] > borough_data['neighbor_waste']) & (borough_data['Waste_value'] > borough_data['Waste_value'].mean()), 'HH', np.where((borough_data['Waste_value'] < borough_data['neighbor_waste']) & (borough_data['Waste_value'] < borough_data['Waste_value'].mean()), 'LL', np.nan))

def permutation_test(data, column, n_permutations=500):
    test_statistic = data[column].mean()
    shuffled_values = np.array([data[column].sample(frac=1, replace=True).mean() for _ in range(n_permutations)])
    p_value = np.mean(np.abs(test_statistic - shuffled_values) > np.abs(test_statistic))
